Correction (other:workflow): Using unquoted heredoc delimiter <<EOF in bash commands, causing variable expansion, quote mangling, and shell interpretation of special characters ($, backticks, braces, pipes)
Corrected: Always use quoted heredoc delimiter <<'EOF' to prevent all shell expansion. For SSH with heredoc, write to temp file then SCP. For herestrings <<<, use printf to avoid trailing newline. For long CLI bodies, prefer --body-file with stdin pipe (--body-file -).
